name: Experience
description: Turn a validated user problem into a coherent journey, testable product definition, and PRD-ready evidence.

members.role: Default — outcome, scope, PRD, acceptance criteria, and product decisions
Default — user journey, interaction model, prototype, and experience review
Optional — fill evidence gaps and validate user assumptions
Optional — ensure product promise and user journey stay consistent
Optional — independent usability and acceptance-criteria challenge

entry_criteria: A target user and problem are supported by evidence or explicitly accepted as a test hypothesis
exit_criteria: User-visible behavior and non-goals are testable
Delivery can estimate and implement without re-litigating user intent
